members.name: [KOR]큰왕자ᴷᴼᴿ
known_names:
Neiva Schimanski Fernandes presents today with concern for itchy, red, irritated eyes. She reports that the irritation began as a small area and has since enlarged, with associated itching, flaking, and dryness. The symptoms are present in both eyes and have been persistent despite her use of Aquafor. She is unsure if this is an allergic reaction or a side effect of prior cancer treatment. She notes that the eyelids appear puffy and red, and the irritation was worse a few days ago but improved somewhat with ice application. She also reports intermittent itching at the corner of her mouth. She denies any new medications and states her last cancer treatment was stopped in January due to thyroid-related side effects. She has not resumed immunotherapy since then. She expresses concern that the eye symptoms may be related to her prior treatment but notes the timing makes this less likely.

She also reports a sensation of tightness and mild soreness in her groin area. She has a history of recent emergency department visits for stomach pain, which she attributes to thyroid medication side effects. She is not currently experiencing abdominal pain and denies pain after eating. She has a history of gallbladder concerns and was told there are two cancer cells present. She is scheduled for a PET scan on the twentieth of this month. She discontinued her cholesterol medication (simvastatin) due to the burden of multiple medications and radiation therapy but is considering restarting it after discussion today. She continues to take two blood pressure medications daily and reports her blood pressure is well controlled.
